# PyAutoLens Visualization Gallery

<!-- Generated by gallery/gallery_build.py from scripts/<domain>/images/. Do not edit by hand: rerun `bash gallery/gallery_run.sh --all`. -->

Rendered with PyAutoLens `2026.8.17.1` · 106 figures.

Most figures are outputs that the PyAutoLens visualizers (`VisualizerImaging`, `VisualizerInterferometer`, `VisualizerPoint`, `VisualizerWeak`) write to a model-fit's `image/` folder. Pandora shows 24 observed images across seven families with source-plane diagnostics from a fixed starting model. For the Simple cluster, the first point source is offset by 0.003 arcsec in y. See [README.md](README.md) for how to improve one.
